Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body: This looks exactly like a Jay-Kristoff deck... nobody knows what the deck does exactly, except the player winning games with it.

Messages.Author: Kushiel
Messages.Body:
> extrala wrote:
> This looks exactly like a Jay-Kristoff deck... nobody knows what the deck does exactly, except the player winning games with it.
>
Really? It looks pretty obvious to me.

Vykos gives you a lot of extra discards. Ashur Tablets lets you get back the cards that are useful in the situation you find yourself in. The rest is pretty standard Tzim intercept/combat.

Think Anson/Ashurs gun wall, only replacing Liquidation with Vykos' special.
